key_findings.finding: The pinacol boronate ester is the best-supported Suzuki–Miyaura partner. ORD records repeatedly include this exact heteroaryl boronate with an isoquinoline-type electrophile and give high yields (100.0% in several records; 99.0% in a record listing KOH, acetonitrile, and a bulky biaryl phosphine/Pd catalyst system). The electrophile in these records is isoquinolinyl iodide, not the queried 6-bromoisoquinoline, so these are close empirical analogues rather than an exact reaction match.

source_tools.relevance: ORD reaction records for exact boronate and isoquinoline-type coupling partner; record 5 has KOH/acetonitrile and 99.0% yield.

key_findings.finding: The database results provide no empirical record for the potassium organotrifluoroborate or the corresponding heteroaryl bromide as coupling partner under the stated conditions. The queried 6-bromoisoquinoline is an electrophilic aryl halide, so among the three listed heteroaryl candidates, the boronate ester is the one directly supported by the matching Suzuki records; choosing it over the trifluoroborate for maximizing yield is an evidence-based preference from the available records, not a head-to-head comparison.
